_comment: Four openccu-lite test systems (interface processes of OpenCCU 3.89.11) as they answered on 2026-09-29,
dumped by tools/dump-ccu.js and merged into one set: listDevices, getParamsetDescription for every
paramset the devices announce, getLinks and listBidcosInterfaces. Anonymised: serials, HmIP addresses,
SGTINs and RF addresses are replaced consistently, link names emptied; types, firmware, versions, flags
and channel layouts are as the systems reported them. Every paramset of every device resolves to a
description of its exact firmware. A real CCU lists one HmIP radio module; this merged set has three.
